title: B2B Ecommerce Platform in India for Dealer Orders
description: A B2B ecommerce platform for Indian suppliers: dealers order online at their own prices, on credit within your limit, and download statements. What it lacks, too.
ogTitle: A B2B ecommerce platform for Indian suppliers and their dealers
ogDescription: Dealer prices, credit limits that stop an order, statements, approvals and quotes on your own web address. No GST invoices or Tally sync yet, and the page says so.
h1: A B2B ecommerce platform for Indian suppliers and their dealers
lede: GoCommerce lets a manufacturer or distributor take its dealers’ orders online. Each dealer signs in on your own web address, orders by product code at their own prices, buys on credit up to the limit you set, and downloads a statement of what they owe. It is open source. It does not make GST tax invoices or connect to Tally yet, and this page lists what else is missing.

story.title: Which trades it fits today
paras: It fits best where dealers reorder known products by code and buy on credit: electricals and fans, tiles, sanitaryware, plywood and pipes, and auto parts sold by part number. Each has its own page below, with what that trade asks for.

It does not fit yet where the law or the trade needs more than the software has. Medicines and crop protection need batch and expiry records and a licence check on every buyer. Jewellery is priced by weight at the day’s gold rate. FMCG distribution runs on salespeople taking orders shop by shop. None of these is built yet.

gapsLede: What an Indian supplier will ask about that is not there yet. Read these before you plan a launch.

faq.q: What is a B2B ecommerce platform?
faq.a: Software that lets businesses order from you online instead of by phone, email or a salesperson. Here that means your dealers and distributors sign in, see their own prices and credit, place orders and download statements, while you set the terms in an admin.

faq.q: Can our dealers buy on credit?
faq.a: Yes. Give each dealer a credit limit and payment days. An order on account is confirmed straight away with a due date, and an order that would take the dealer past their limit is refused at checkout, before it exists.

No. The invoice prints your GSTIN, but it has no HSN codes, no CGST, SGST or IGST lines and no place of supply, and it does not generate e-invoices or e-way bills. Keep your billing software for tax invoices.
Not by itself. Orders, customers and statements export as spreadsheets, and a developer can connect another system through webhooks and the API.

faq.q: Do we need a website first?
faq.a: No. Dealers sign in at /portal on your store’s own web address. A public website for customers can come later, or never.

Running the open-source code on your own server is free. A store hosted on kitcommerce.store pays {hostedFee} of each successful sale. If you would rather someone set it up, the team behind GoCommerce builds stores to order.
